targets.summary: Have the function build a unique result-variable name internally, the way append_cxx_flag_if_supported does, instead of making the caller pass one in.
targets.evidence: Before: `function(add_link_options_if_supported flag var)` with `check_linker_flag(C "LINKER:${flag}" ${var})`. Merged: `function(add_link_options_if_supported flag)`, and the variable name is now built inside the function with `string(TOUPPER "HAS_LINKER${flag}" _FLAG_NAME)` and `string(REGEX REPLACE "[=,-]" "_" _FLAG_NAME ...)`, then passed as `check_linker_flag(C "LINKER:${flag}" ${_FLAG_NAME})`. This follows the append_cxx_flag_if_supported pattern, and the comment saying the caller must pass a unique var name was removed.
